name: @gaiadesk/mcp
description: Launcher for the GaiaDesk MCP server: finds gaiadesk-cli and runs `gaiadesk-cli mcp` over stdio.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'dist-test']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/locate.test.js dist-test/bridge.test.js dist-test/launcher.test.js dist-test/package.test.js
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
